```c title="C"
#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include "html_to_markdown.h"

int main(void) {
    HTMAlefHandle options_handle = htm_conversion_options_from_json("{\"code_block_style\":\"Backticks\"}");
    HTMAlefHandle result = htm_convert("<pre><code class=\"language-js\">console.log('hi');</code></pre>", options_handle);
    htm_conversion_options_free(options_handle);
    htm_conversion_result_free(result);

}
```
